newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Nov bank credit rises 15.6 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Nov bank credit rises 15.6 pct on year.

text.p: Bank credit to non-bank customers (in billions of Singapore dollars):

The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) said in its monthly report that bank credit expanded at a slightly slower rate of 15.6 percent year-on-year in November, compared with 16.2 percent in October.
Overall credit growth was dampened by a slowdown in loans to the building and construction, and transport sectors.
Growth of loans to the building and construction sector, including housing loans, fell to 20 percent in November from 22 percent in the previous month.
Loans to the transport sector and financial institutions moderated with growth rates of 25 and 12 percent respectively, from 29 and 14 percent in October.
But growth of loans to the manufacturing sector picked up marginally.
Credit growth in the commerce sector and personal loans strengthened to 10 and 22 percent respectively, from 7.0 and 21 percent in October.
